messages:
elaine: Morning — quick conductor check. Cut window in ~2h. Posting queued cherry-picks and known blockers. Please call out anything that will prevent the cut.

sam: quick list pls, I'll triage reviews.

elaine: copy — here's current queue:
```
- PR #4672 (runtime): backpressure fix, needs QA signoff
- PR #4680 (deploy): canary rollout change, awaiting infra smoke 
- PR #4691 (console): telemetry opt tweak, needs a docs patch
- PR #4703 (batching): quantization flag, flaky e2e failing
```

ravi: I can take #4672 review now. ETA 30m.

cheng: #4703 flaky e2e is failing on long-seq tests — reproducer started on my workstation, looks like KV-cache race under high batch sizes. I can open a hotfix branch if we want to back out.

elaine: thanks. If we can't stabilize #4703 by cut, let's mark it as hold and proceed — batching change can be deferred. Thoughts?

sam: agree. Keep runtime backpressure and canary deploy in. Those are needed for SLA.

ravi: reviewed #4672 — left 2 tiny nits, non-blocking. QA is green locally. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Build 1939991111 — all checks passed for PR #4680. Canary rollout scheduled at +30m.

elaine: ok, plan: cut will include #4672 and #4680. Hold #4703 and #4691 (docs) can merge post-cut.

cheng: I'll open a short-lived branch for a KV-cache guard to stabilize #4703; won't block the release.

sam: pinging @platform-team for infra smoke verification — @cheng can you paste the smoke command?

cheng: smoke command: ```kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/redwood-runtime-canary --timeout=120s```

sam: ran smoke — looks clean from my side. Canary latency within SLO.

srebot: Observed a 3min GC spike on one canary pod at 1939991218; pod recovered, no error traces in logs. Filing ticket INF-912.

elaine: noted. Not blocking for cut but assign INF-912 to eng-runtime.

ravi: will land #4672 once I apply nits, then trigger the cut.

elaine: thanks everyone — I'll start the release cut in 10m. If anything changes, post in this thread. :rocket:
